description: Crop a placed graphic by moving its frame's edges while the graphic stays put, move the graphic inside its frame, or scale it within the frame, as with the Direct Selection tool or content grabber

crop.description: Move each frame edge inward by this many mm (negative moves it outward, uncovering more of the graphic)

moveContent.description: Move the graphic inside the frame by an offset

scaleContent.description: Scale the graphic inside the frame

target.description: Frames holding graphics. Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: adjust_frame_content
title: Adjust Frame Content
